notes.title: is released now!
notes.notes:
[b]4X games <Goblin Times> is just released into EA. [/b]
This games is now with a discount 21% off
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36256913/603073ab9bad4f23d02a2f132c494dde39a9e564.png[/img]

In this game, player will choose one leader to build your own kingdom. It is your choice whether to develop your economic or build your reputation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36256913/ac856bc0780ec1dbf80cc34a477bfddf0e696d7c.png[/img]

There are 5 basic resources in this game: gold, food, assistants, reputation and happiness, it is relevant to your development, player need to plan the land resource to improve your resource, and improve yourself with these resources at the same time.

And there are also some other resources like ores in the map. Its influence is not obviously in the early game, but it is very important in the late game, so players should try to get more for your late game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36256913/f213328f81176466a4a926502ef8ee70b912a016.png[/img]

There are 8 different leaders you can choose now, each one has their own advantages, let’s go to  explore in the goblin times!
